{
  "content": "\"\"\"S8 hypothesis: dumbbell cavity + snap holes + fillet (excl. hole rims).\n\nProbes on the real body chain (s3 + cavity + holes -> fillet):\n  H1 cavity cut: floor plane at y=back_y+cavity_h exists as ONE planar +Y face\n     with area ~= outline area (waist 56x11 + 2 x 19.5x15).\n  H2 snap holes: 4 cylindrical hole walls, axis Z, centers (±12, 8.9), r=1.25,\n     length 4 (z 5.5->9.5).\n  H3 fillet with hole-rim edges EXCLUDED succeeds; with rims included must\n     fail/degrade (known-bad: R1.2 ~ hole radius 1.25).\n  H4 membrane: sample grid inside outline: material above floor exists\n     (y_top >= floor + fillet_r + 1.0) -> probed on final solid via classifier.\n  H5 named faces (mount/back) re-tag still resolve after cavity+fillet.\n\"\"\"\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nfrom simplecadapi import ql  # noqa: E402\nfrom simplecadapi import GraphSession  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.gp import gp_Pnt  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON  # noqa: E402\n\nP = dict(L=80.0, D=20.0, rod_d=30.0, thickness=6.0, d_motor=30.0,\n         r_corner=17.0, fillet_r=1.2, back_cut_frac=0.75)\nWZ, PZ, WX, PX2 = 5.5, 7.5, 28.0, 47.5\nCAV_H, SNAP_D, SNAP_X, SNAP_Y, SNAP_LEN = 3.0, 2.5, 12.0, 8.9, 4.0\nr = P[\"rod_d\"] / 2.0\nby = 7.5\nfloor_y = by + CAV_H\n\n\ndef in_outline(x, z):\n    return abs(z) <= WZ + 0.01 or (WX <= abs(x) <= PX2 + 0.01 and abs(z) <= PZ + 0.01)\n\n\ndef cavity_tool():\n    ovs = 5.0\n    faces = []\n    for sx in (-1, 1):\n        w = u_link.scad.make_rectangle_rface(width=2 * WX, height=2 * WZ, center=(0.0, floor_y, 0.0), normal=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0))\n        faces.append(w)\n    return None  # placeholder; real construction below\n\n\ndef build_body_s8():\n    body = u_link.build_stage(\"s3\")\n    # cavity cut: dumbbell prism = union of boxes (waist slab + 2 pocket slabs), y in [by, floor_y]\n    ovs = 0.2\n    waist = u_link.scad.make_box_rsolid(\n        width=2 * WX, height=CAV_H, depth=2 * WZ,\n        bottom_face_center=(0.0, by, 0.0))\n    pockets = [\n        u_link.scad.make_box_rsolid(\n            width=PX2 - WX, height=CAV_H, depth=2 * PZ,\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * (WX + PX2) / 2.0, by, 0.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    body = u_link.scad.cut_rsolid(body, [waist + ovs if False else waist, *pockets])\n    return body\n\n\nwith GraphSession(graph_id=\"s8_hyp\") as session:\n    body = build_body_s8()\n    v_after_cav = body.get_volume()\n    print(f\"H1 volume after cavity={v_after_cav:.3f}\")\n    floors = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \">=\", 0.999),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", floor_y - 0.05),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", floor_y + 0.05),\n    )).resolve(body)\n    area_expect = 2 * WX * 2 * WZ + 2 * (PX2 - WX) * 2 * PZ\n    print(f\"H1 floor faces n={len(floors)} areas={[f'{f.get_area():.1f}' for f in floors]} expect~{area_expect:.1f}\")\n    assert len(floors) >= 1\n\n    # H2 snap holes\n    holes = [\n        u_link.scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n            radius=SNAP_D / 2.0, height=SNAP_LEN,\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * SNAP_X, SNAP_Y, WZ), axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    body = u_link.scad.cut_rsolid(body, holes)\n    walls = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * (SNAP_D / 2) * SNAP_LEN * 0.9),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * (SNAP_D / 2) * SNAP_LEN * 1.1),\n    )).resolve(body)\n    print(f\"H2 snap hole walls n={len(walls)} areas={[f'{w.get_area():.2f}' for w in walls]}\")\n    assert len(walls) == 4, f\"expected 4 hole walls, got {len(walls)}\"\n\n    # H5 tags re-apply (cut breaks lineage)\n    body = u_link.scad.apply_tag_rselection(scope=body, targets=u_link._floor_selector(-P[\"L\"] / 2.0, P), tag=u_link.TAG_MOUNT_LEFT)\n    body = u_link.scad.apply_tag_rselection(scope=body, targets=u_link._floor_selector(P[\"L\"] / 2.0, P), tag=u_link.TAG_MOUNT_RIGHT)\n    body = u_link.scad.apply_tag_rselection(scope=body, targets=u_link._back_selector(P), tag=u_link.TAG_BACK)\n\n    # H3 fillet excluding hole rims\n    snap_rim_edges = []\n    other_edges = []\n    circ = 2 * math.pi * (SNAP_D / 2.0)\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        near_hole = any(\n            abs(c.x - sx * SNAP_X) < 0.3 and abs(c.y - SNAP_Y) < 0.3\n            and (abs(c.z - WZ) < 0.3 or abs(c.z - (WZ + SNAP_LEN)) < 0.3)\n            for sx in (-1, 1))\n        if near_hole and abs(e.get_length() - circ) < 0.1:\n            snap_rim_edges.append(e)\n        else:\n            other_edges.append(e)\n    print(f\"H3 selection card: total={len(body.get_edges())} snap_rims={len(snap_rim_edges)} filleted={len(other_edges)}\")\n    assert len(snap_rim_edges) == 8  # 4 holes x (mouth + blind bottom)\n\n    try:\n        s8 = u_link.scad.fillet_rsolid(\n            solid=body, edges=other_edges, radius=P[\"fillet_r\"],\n            generated_faces_tag=\"fillet.global_patch\")\n        v8 = s8.get_volume()\n        print(f\"H3 fillet (rims excluded) OK: volume={v8:.3f} (pre-fillet {body.get_volume():.3f})\")\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        print(f\"H3 fillet FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:100]}\")\n        s8 = None\n\n    # H4 membrane grid on final solid\n    if s8 is not None:\n        cls = BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier(s8.wrapped)\n\n        def inside(x, y, z):\n            cls.Perform(gp_Pnt(x, y, z), 1e-7)\n            return cls.State() in (TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON)\n\n        worst = 99.0\n        bad = 0\n        n = 0\n        for x in [x * 1.5 for x in range(-33, 34, 2)] + [±x for ±x in ()]:\n            for z in [z * 0.5 for z in range(-15, 16, 2)]:\n                if in_outline(x, z):\n                    n += 1\n                    y = floor_y + P[\"fillet_r\"] + 1.0\n                    if not inside(x, y, z):\n                        bad += 1\n                    ytop = floor_y + 0.01\n                    while inside(x, ytop, z) and ytop < 25:\n                        ytop += 0.1\n                    worst = min(worst, ytop - floor_y)\n        print(f\"H4 membrane grid: n={n} bad={bad} worst_floor_membrane={worst:.2f} (want >=1.0+fillet)\")\n\n    session.capture_result(value=s8 if s8 is not None else body)\n\nprint(\"S8 hypothesis: probes done\")\n",

  "newString": "def _cavity_tools(p: dict):\n    \"\"\"S8 背腔切削工具：哑铃棱柱（腰板 + 两端腔板），y∈[back_y, back_y+cavity_h]。\"\"\"\n    by = back_y(p)\n    waist = scad.make_box_rsolid(\n        width=2.0 * p[\"waist_x\"], height=p[\"cavity_h\"], depth=2.0 * p[\"waist_z\"],\n        bottom_face_center=(0.0, by, 0.0))\n    pockets = [\n        scad.make_box_rsolid(\n            width=p[\"pocket_x2\"] - p[\"waist_x\"], height=p[\"cavity_h\"],\n            depth=2.0 * p[\"pocket_z\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * (p[\"waist_x\"] + p[\"pocket_x2\"]) / 2.0, by, 0.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    return [waist, *pockets]\n\n\ndef _snap_hole_tools(p: dict):\n    \"\"\"S8 卡扣孔工具：4×盲圆柱（轴 Z，自腰侧壁向外交联）。\"\"\"\n    return [\n        scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n            radius=p[\"snap_hole_d\"] / 2.0, height=p[\"snap_hole_len\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * p[\"snap_x\"], p[\"snap_hole_y\"], p[\"waist_z\"]),\n            axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n\n\ndef _snap_rim_edges(body, p: dict):\n    \"\"\"识别卡扣孔口/孔底圆边（倒角须排除——R1.2≈孔半径 1.25 会毁孔）。\"\"\"\n    circ = 2.0 * math.pi * p[\"snap_hole_d\"] / 2.0\n    rims = []\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        if abs(e.get_length() - circ) > 0.1:\n            continue\n        for sx in (-1, 1):\n            if (abs(c.x - sx * p[\"snap_x\"]) < 0.3\n                    and abs(c.y - p[\"snap_hole_y\"]) < 0.3\n                    and (abs(c.z - p[\"waist_z\"]) < 0.3\n                         or abs(c.z - (p[\"waist_z\"] + p[\"snap_hole_len\"])) < 0.3)):\n                rims.append(e)\n                break\n    return rims\n\n\ndef _build_chain_ops(stage: str):",
  "oldString": "def _build_chain_ops(stage: str):"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"S8 hypothesis: cavity+snap holes live in the chain (single session).\n\nH1 cavity floor: ONE planar +Y face at y=back_y+cavity_h, area ~= outline.\nH2 snap holes: 4 cylindrical walls r=1.25 len=4.\nH3 fillet excluding 8 hole rims succeeds; rim edges correctly identified (8).\nH4 membrane grid on final solid: floor+fillet+1.0 material above floor.\nH5 named faces (mount/back) resolve on final solid.\n\"\"\"\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nfrom simplecadapi import ql  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.gp import gp_Pnt  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON  # noqa: E402\n\nP = u_link.params()\nby = u_link.back_y(P)\nfloor_y = by + P[\"cavity_h\"]\nfailures = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    print(f\"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}\")\n    if not ok:\n        failures.append(name)\n\n\nbody = u_link.build_stage(\"s4\")\n\n# H1\nfloors = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n    ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \">=\", 0.999),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", floor_y - 0.05),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", floor_y + 0.05),\n)).resolve(body)\narea_expect = 2 * P[\"waist_x\"] * 2 * P[\"waist_z\"] + 2 * (P[\"pocket_x2\"] - P[\"waist_x\"]) * 2 * P[\"pocket_z\"]\ncheck(\"H1 cavity floor\", len(floors) == 1 and floors[0].get_area() > 0.9 * area_expect,\n      f\"n={len(floors)} area={floors[0].get_area():.1f} expect~{area_expect:.1f}\" if floors else \"n=0\")\n\n# H2\nwalls = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n    ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * (P[\"snap_hole_d\"] / 2) * P[\"snap_hole_len\"] * 0.9),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * (P[\"snap_hole_d\"] / 2) * P[\"snap_hole_len\"] * 1.1),\n)).resolve(body)\ncheck(\"H2 snap hole walls\", len(walls) == 4, f\"n={len(walls)} areas={[f'{w.get_area():.2f}' for w in walls]}\")\n\n# H3 (rim identification already asserted inside chain; verify fillet landed)\npatch = ql.faces().where(ql.tag(\"fillet.global_patch\")).resolve(body)\ncheck(\"H3 fillet landed\", len(patch) >= 1, f\"patch faces n={len(patch)}\")\n\n# H4 membrane grid\ncls = BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier(body.wrapped)\n\n\ndef inside(x, y, z):\n    cls.Perform(gp_Pnt(x, y, z), 1e-7)\n    return cls.State() in (TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON)\n\n\ndef in_outline(x, z):\n    return abs(z) <= P[\"waist_z\"] + 0.01 or (\n        P[\"waist_x\"] <= abs(x) <= P[\"pocket_x2\"] + 0.01 and abs(z) <= P[\"pocket_z\"] + 0.01)\n\n\nbad = 0\nn = 0\nfor xi in range(-33, 34, 2):\n    x = xi * 1.5\n    for zi in range(-15, 16, 2):\n        z = zi * 0.5\n        if in_outline(x, z):\n            n += 1\n            if not inside(x, floor_y + P[\"fillet_r\"] + 1.0, z):\n                bad += 1\ncheck(\"H4 membrane above floor\", bad == 0, f\"grid n={n} bad={bad}\")\n\n# H5\nok5 = True\nfor tag in (u_link.TAG_MOUNT_LEFT, u_link.TAG_MOUNT_RIGHT, u_link.TAG_BACK):\n    hit = ql.faces().where(ql.tag(tag)).resolve(body)\n    ok5 = ok5 and len(hit) == 1\ncheck(\"H5 named faces\", ok5)\n\n# H6 pc=8 coverage (2D analytic)\npc = 8.0\nhole_r = 1.5\npts = []\nfor deg in (45, 135, 225, 315):\n    a = math.radians(deg)\n    for cx in (-P[\"L\"] / 2.0, P[\"L\"] / 2.0):\n        pts.append((cx + pc * math.cos(a), pc * math.sin(a)))\nbad_pts = [(x, z) for x, z in pts if not in_outline(x, z)]\n# hole edge worst point: center + r towards +x and +z diag already included by r\nedge_bad = []\nfor x, z in pts:\n    for dx, dz in ((hole_r, 0), (0, hole_r), (hole_r / math.sqrt(2), hole_r / math.sqrt(2))):\n        if not in_outline(x + dx * math.copysign(1, x), z + dz):\n            edge_bad.append((round(x + dx, 2), round(z + dz, 2)))\ncheck(\"H6 pc=8 coverage\", not bad_pts and not edge_bad,\n      f\"centers_bad={bad_pts} edges_bad={edge_bad}\")\n\nprint(f\"S8 hypothesis: {'ALL PASS' if not failures else 'FAILED ' + str(failures)}\")\nsys.exit(1 if failures else 0)\n",
  "filePath": "/Users/lildino/Project/ocws/SimpleCADAPI/examples/u_link_motor_mount/verify/s8_hypothesis.py"
}

{
  "filePath": "/Users/lildino/Project/ocws/SimpleCADAPI/examples/u_link_motor_mount/u_link.py",
  "newString": "def _split_snap_rims(body, p: dict):\n    \"\"\"单次遍历分离（卡扣孔口/孔底圆弧段, 其余边）。\n\n    注 1: get_edges() 每次返回新包装实例, 对象恒等比较不可靠——必须单次遍历分类。\n    注 2: OCP 圆柱面 seam 使孔口圆边断成多段弧（s8 调试取证: 每端 2~3 段,\n          各段质心偏离圆心）——判据用\"边中心到孔轴距离 < 孔半径+0.4\"。\n    \"\"\"\n    hr = p[\"snap_hole_d\"] / 2.0\n    full_circ = 2.0 * math.pi * hr\n    rims, others = [], []\n    rim_len = 0.0\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        is_rim = False\n        if e.get_length() < full_circ + 0.1:\n            for sx in (-1, 1):\n                ax, ay = sx * p[\"snap_x\"], p[\"snap_hole_y\"]\n                if ((c.x - ax) ** 2 + (c.y - ay) ** 2) < (hr + 0.4) ** 2 and (\n                        abs(c.z - p[\"waist_z\"]) < 0.3\n                        or abs(c.z - (p[\"waist_z\"] + p[\"snap_hole_len\"])) < 0.3):\n                    is_rim = True\n                    break\n        if is_rim:\n            rims.append(e)\n            rim_len += e.get_length()\n        else:\n            others.append(e)\n    return rims, others, rim_len",
  "oldString": "def _split_snap_rims(body, p: dict):\n    \"\"\"单次遍历分离（卡扣孔口/孔底圆边, 其余边）。\n\n    注: get_edges() 每次返回新包装实例, 对象恒等比较不可靠——必须单次遍历分类。\n    \"\"\"\n    circ = 2.0 * math.pi * p[\"snap_hole_d\"] / 2.0\n    rims, others = [], []\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        is_rim = False\n        if abs(e.get_length() - circ) < 0.1:\n            for sx in (-1, 1):\n                if (abs(c.x - sx * p[\"snap_x\"]) < 0.3\n                        and abs(c.y - p[\"snap_hole_y\"]) < 0.3\n                        and (abs(c.z - p[\"waist_z\"]) < 0.3\n                             or abs(c.z - (p[\"waist_z\"] + p[\"snap_hole_len\"])) < 0.3)):\n                    is_rim = True\n                    break\n        (rims if is_rim else others).append(e)\n    return rims, others"

{
  "content": "\"\"\"S8 diag: bisect which edge group kills the global fillet.\"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nimport simplecadapi as scad  # noqa: E402\n\nP = u_link.params()\nFR = P[\"fillet_r\"]\n\nwith scad.GraphSession(graph_id=\"s8_diag\") as session:\n    body = u_link._build_chain_ops(\"s3\")\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._cavity_tools(P))\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._snap_hole_tools(P))\n    rims, others = u_link._split_snap_rims(body, P)\n    print(f\"total={len(rims) + len(others)} rims={len(rims)} others={len(others)}\")\n\n    def try_fillet(solid, edges, label):\n        try:\n            r = scad.fillet_rsolid(solid=solid, edges=edges, radius=FR)\n            print(f\"  {label}: OK (n={len(edges)})\")\n            return r\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            print(f\"  {label}: FAIL (n={len(edges)}) {type(exc).__name__}\")\n            return None\n\n    # group others by y-band of edge center\n    def band(e):\n        y = e.get_center().y\n        if y < P[\"waist_z\"] - 0.5:\n            return \"low\"\n        if abs(y - (u_link.back_y(P) + P[\"cavity_h\"])) < 1.0:\n            return \"cavity\"\n        if y > 14.0:\n            return \"top\"\n        return \"mid\"\n\n    groups = {}\n    for e in others:\n        groups.setdefault(band(e), []).append(e)\n    for k, v in sorted(groups.items()):\n        print(f\"group {k}: n={len(v)} lens={[round(x.get_length(), 2) for x in v[:6]]}\")\n        try_fillet(body, v, f\"band {k}\")\n\n    # cumulative: all bands except one\n    for skip in sorted(groups):\n        edges = [e for k, v in groups.items() if k != skip for e in v]\n        try_fillet(body, edges, f\"all minus {skip}\")\n\n    session.capture_result(value=body)\nprint(\"diag done\")\n",
  "filePath": "/Users/lildino/Project/ocws/SimpleCADAPI/examples/u_link_motor_mount/verify/s8_diag_fillet.py"
}

{
  "content": "\"\"\"S8 diag2: recursive bisection to find the edge(s) that kill the fillet.\"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nimport simplecadapi as scad  # noqa: E402\n\nP = u_link.params()\nFR = P[\"fillet_r\"]\n\nwith scad.GraphSession(graph_id=\"s8_diag2\") as session:\n    body = u_link._build_chain_ops(\"s3\")\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._cavity_tools(P))\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._snap_hole_tools(P))\n    rims, others = u_link._split_snap_rims(body, P)\n\n    def ok(edges):\n        try:\n            scad.fillet_rsolid(solid=body, edges=edges, radius=FR)\n            return True\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n            return False\n\n    def bisect(edges, depth=0):\n        if ok(edges):\n            print(f\"{'  '*depth}OK n={len(edges)}\")\n            return []\n        if len(edges) == 1:\n            e = edges[0]\n            c = e.get_center()\n            print(f\"{'  '*depth}POISON len={e.get_length():.3f} c=({c.x:.2f},{c.y:.2f},{c.z:.2f})\")\n            return edges\n        h = len(edges) // 2\n        print(f\"{'  '*depth}split {len(edges)} -> {h}+{len(edges)-h}\")\n        return bisect(edges[:h], depth + 1) + bisect(edges[h:], depth + 1)\n\n    poison = bisect(others)\n    print(f\"poison edges: {len(poison)}\")\n    for e in poison:\n        c = e.get_center()\n        print(f\"  len={e.get_length():.3f} c=({c.x:.3f},{c.y:.3f},{c.z:.3f})\")\n    session.capture_result(value=body)\nprint(\"diag2 done\")\n",

}

{
  "content": "\"\"\"S8 diag3: per-group fillet test, one subprocess per group (crash-safe).\n\nUsage: uv run python verify/s8_diag3.py <group>\nGroups partition the non-rim edges; each subprocess builds the chain fresh\nand attempts to fillet exactly one group. Exit 0 = OK, 3 = FAIL(exc), 139 =\nkernel segfault (reported by shell).\n\"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nimport simplecadapi as scad  # noqa: E402\n\nP = u_link.params()\nFR = P[\"fillet_r\"]\nBY = u_link.back_y(P)\nFY = BY + P[\"cavity_h\"]\n\n\ndef group_of(e):\n    c = e.get_center()\n    in_cavity_xy = (abs(c.z) <= P[\"pocket_z\"] + 0.3 and abs(c.x) <= P[\"pocket_x2\"] + 0.3)\n    if abs(c.y - FY) < 0.3 and in_cavity_xy:\n        return \"cavity_floor_rim\"     # 槽底-腔壁交线\n    if abs(c.y - BY) < 0.3 and in_cavity_xy:\n        return \"cavity_back_rim\"      # 腔壁-back face 交线\n    if abs(c.y - BY) < 0.3:\n        return \"backface_outer\"       # back face 外缘\n    if c.y > 14.0:\n        return \"mount_area\"           # 电机槽/端面\n    if abs(abs(c.x) - P[\"waist_x\"]) < 0.3 and P[\"waist_z\"] < abs(c.z) <= P[\"pocket_z\"] + 0.3:\n        return \"cavity_step\"          # 腰-腔台阶竖边\n    return \"rest\"\n\n\nGROUPS = (\"cavity_floor_rim\", \"cavity_back_rim\", \"backface_outer\", \"mount_area\", \"cavity_step\", \"rest\")\n\ngroup = sys.argv[1]\nwith scad.GraphSession(graph_id=f\"s8_diag3_{group}\") as session:\n    body = u_link._build_chain_ops(\"s3\")\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._cavity_tools(P))\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._snap_hole_tools(P))\n    rims, others = u_link._split_snap_rims(body, P)\n    picked = [e for e in others if group_of(e) == group]\n    print(f\"group={group} n={len(picked)} lens={sorted(round(e.get_length(), 2) for e in picked)[:8]}\")\n    if not picked:\n        sys.exit(0)\n    scad.fillet_rsolid(solid=body, edges=picked, radius=FR, generated_faces_tag=\"diag.patch\")\n    print(f\"group={group} FILLET OK\")\n    session.capture_result(value=body)\nsys.exit(0)\n",

## [角色切换：验证规划员 (S9)] — 探针（boss+筋+全局倒角稳定性）

**[tool: write]** status=completed

```json
{
  "content": "\"\"\"S9 hypothesis: boss posts + ribs inside cavity, fillet stability, cover fit.\n\nProbes (all on real chain via temporary s9 ops in ONE GraphSession — reusing\nu_link._build_chain_ops('s3') is session-safe because probe rebuilds everything\ninside its own session through build_stage-compatible path).\n\nSince chain s4 doesn't yet include bosses, this probe builds:\n  s3 -> cavity -> boss union -> hole cut -> ribs union -> fillet(exclusions) -> chamfer\nand checks:\n  H1 bosses exist: 4 CYLINDER faces r=2.5 len=3.0 at (±39, ±3.5), axis Y.\n  H2 boss holes: 4 CYLINDER walls r=1.35 len=2.5.\n  H3 global fillet (excluding boss-hole rims, boss top edges, rib edges,\n     backface outer, short edges) COMPLETES.\n  H4 boss top chamfer 0.5 completes; boss top face annulus area ~= pi(2.0^2-1.35^2).\n  H5 volume delta in analytic band (bosses+ribs minus holes).\n  H6 named faces (mount/back) re-tag after all ops.\n\"\"\"\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nimport simplecadapi as scad  # noqa: E402\nfrom simplecadapi import ql  # noqa: E402\n\nP = dict(L=80.0, D=20.0, rod_d=30.0, thickness=6.0, d_motor=30.0,\n         r_corner=17.0, fillet_r=1.2, back_cut_frac=0.75,\n         waist_z=5.5, pocket_z=7.5, waist_x=28.0, pocket_x2=47.5, cavity_h=3.0)\nBOSS_D, BHOLE_D, BHOLE_DEPTH = 5.0, 2.7, 2.5\nBOSS_X, BOSS_Z = 39.0, 3.5\nRIB_T, RIB_H, RIB_LEN = 1.2, 1.5, 2.5\nCHAM = 0.5\nby = u_link.back_y(P)\nfloor_y = by + P[\"cavity_h\"]\nfailures = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    print(f\"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}\")\n    if not ok:\n        failures.append(name)\n\n\nwith scad.GraphSession(graph_id=\"s9_hyp\") as session:\n    body = u_link._build_chain_ops(\"s3\")\n    v0 = body.get_volume()\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, u_link._cavity_tools(P))\n    v_cav = body.get_volume()\n\n    bosses = [\n        scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n            radius=BOSS_D / 2.0, height=P[\"cavity_h\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * BOSS_X, by, sz * BOSS_Z), axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1) for sz in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    body = scad.union_rsolid(body, *bosses)\n\n    holes = [\n        scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n            radius=BHOLE_D / 2.0, height=BHOLE_DEPTH,\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * BOSS_X, by, sz * BOSS_Z), axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1) for sz in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    body = scad.cut_rsolid(body, holes)\n\n    ribs = [\n        scad.make_box_rsolid(\n            width=2.0 * (BOSS_D / 2.0 + RIB_LEN), height=RIB_H, depth=RIB_T,\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * BOSS_X, floor_y - RIB_H / 2.0, sz * BOSS_Z - RIB_T / 2.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1) for sz in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    body = scad.union_rsolid(body, *ribs)\n    v_ribs = body.get_volume()\n\n    # H1 boss cylinders\n    boss_walls = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * 2.5 * P[\"cavity_h\"] * 0.95),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * 2.5 * P[\"cavity_h\"] * 1.05),\n    )).resolve(body)\n    check(\"H1 boss walls\", len(boss_walls) == 4, f\"n={len(boss_walls)}\")\n\n    # H2 hole walls\n    hole_walls = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * 1.35 * BHOLE_DEPTH * 0.95),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * 1.35 * BHOLE_DEPTH * 1.05),\n    )).resolve(body)\n    check(\"H2 boss hole walls\", len(hole_walls) == 4, f\"n={len(hole_walls)}\")\n\n    # H3 fillet with exclusions\n    hr = BHOLE_D / 2.0\n    br = BOSS_D / 2.0\n    circ_h = 2 * math.pi * hr\n    circ_b = 2 * math.pi * br\n    excluded, included = [], []\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        keep = True\n        for sx in (-1, 1):\n            for sz in (-1, 1):\n                ax, az = sx * BOSS_X, sz * BOSS_Z\n                d2 = (c.x - ax) ** 2 + (c.z - az) ** 2\n                # hole rims (y at by or by+depth) / boss top edge (y~by)\n                if d2 < (hr + 0.6) ** 2 and (abs(c.y - by) < 0.3 or abs(c.y - (by + BHOLE_DEPTH)) < 0.3):\n                    keep = False\n                if d2 < (br + 0.6) ** 2 and abs(c.y - by) < 0.3 and abs(e.get_length() - circ_b) < 0.3:\n                    keep = False\n                # rib edges: inside rib box expanded 0.3\n                if abs(c.x - ax) <= br + RIB_LEN + 0.3 and abs(c.z - az) <= RIB_T / 2 + 0.3 \\\n                        and floor_y - RIB_H - 0.3 <= c.y <= floor_y + 0.05:\n                    keep = False\n        if keep and abs(c.y - by) < 0.3 and not (\n                abs(c.z) <= P[\"pocket_z\"] + 0.3 and abs(c.x) <= P[\"pocket_x2\"] + 0.3):\n            keep = False  # backface outer\n        if keep and e.get_length() < 2.0 * P[\"fillet_r\"] + 0.3:\n            keep = False  # short edges\n        (included if keep else excluded).append(e)\n    print(f\"H3 fillet selection: total={len(included) + len(excluded)} excluded={len(excluded)} included={len(included)}\")\n    try:\n        body = scad.fillet_rsolid(solid=body, edges=included, radius=P[\"fillet_r\"],\n                                  generated_faces_tag=\"fillet.global_patch\")\n        check(\"H3 fillet\", True, f\"included={len(included)}\")\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        check(\"H3 fillet\", False, f\"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:80]}\")\n        session.capture_result(value=body)\n        sys.exit(1)\n\n    # H4 boss top chamfer\n    top_edges = []\n    circ_b = 2 * math.pi * br\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        if abs(c.y - by) > 0.3 or abs(e.get_length() - circ_b) > 0.3:\n            continue\n        for sx in (-1, 1):\n            for sz in (-1, 1):\n                if ((c.x - sx * BOSS_X) ** 2 + (c.z - sz * BOSS_Z) ** 2) < (br + 0.6) ** 2:\n                    top_edges.append(e)\n                    break\n            else:\n                continue\n            break\n    print(f\"H4 boss top edges n={len(top_edges)}\")\n    try:\n        body = scad.chamfer_rsolid(solid=body, edges=top_edges, distance=CHAM)\n        tops = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n            ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n            ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \"<=\", -0.999),\n            ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", by - 0.05),\n            ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", by + 0.05),\n            ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 3.0), ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 30.0),\n        )).resolve(body)\n        annulus = math.pi * ((br - CHAM) ** 2 - hr ** 2)\n        check(\"H4 chamfer+annulus\", len(tops) == 4\n              and all(abs(f.get_area() - annulus) < 1.5 for f in tops),\n              f\"n={len(tops)} areas={[f'{f.get_area():.2f}' for f in tops]} annulus~{annulus:.2f}\")\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        check(\"H4 chamfer\", False, f\"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:80]}\")\n\n    # H5 volume band\n    v_final = body.get_volume()\n    boss_v = 4 * (math.pi * br ** 2 * P[\"cavity_h\"] - math.pi * hr ** 2 * BHOLE_DEPTH)\n    rib_v_max = 4 * (2 * (br + RIB_LEN) * RIB_H * RIB_T)\n    check(\"H5 volume band\", v_cav + boss_v < v_final < v_cav + boss_v + rib_v_max,\n          f\"v_cav={v_cav:.1f} v_final={v_final:.1f} added={v_final - v_cav:.1f} \"\n          f\"band=({boss_v:.1f},{boss_v + rib_v_max:.1f})\")\n\n    # H6 re-tag named faces\n    body = scad.apply_tag_rselection(scope=body, targets=u_link._floor_selector(-P[\"L\"] / 2.0, P), tag=u_link.TAG_MOUNT_LEFT)\n    body = scad.apply_tag_rselection(scope=body, targets=u_link._floor_selector(P[\"L\"] / 2.0, P), tag=u_link.TAG_MOUNT_RIGHT)\n    body = scad.apply_tag_rselection(scope=body, targets=u_link._back_selector(P), tag=u_link.TAG_BACK)\n    ok6 = all(len(ql.faces().where(ql.tag(t)).resolve(body)) == 1\n              for t in (u_link.TAG_MOUNT_LEFT, u_link.TAG_MOUNT_RIGHT, u_link.TAG_BACK))\n    check(\"H6 named faces\", ok6)\n\n    session.capture_result(value=body)\n\nprint(f\"S9 hypothesis: {'ALL PASS' if not failures else 'FAILED ' + str(failures)}\")\nsys.exit(1 if failures else 0)\n",
  "filePath": "/Users/lildino/Project/ocws/SimpleCADAPI/examples/u_link_motor_mount/verify/s9_hypothesis.py"
}

sx * BOSS_X) ** 2 + (c.z - sz * BOSS_Z) ** 2) < (BR + 1.0) ** 2\n        for sx in (-1, 1) for sz in (-1, 1))\n    if near_boss_axis:\n        if abs(c.y - FY) < 0.3:\n            return \"boss_root\"            # boss/筋 根部-腔底交线\n        if RIB_IN - 0.3 <= min(\n                (abs(c.x - sx * BOSS_X) for sx in (-1, 1))) <= RIB_OUT + 0.3 \\\n                and abs(c.z % (2 * BOSS_Z)) <= BOSS_Z + 0.3 and FY - RIB_H - 0.3 <= c.y <= FY + 0.3:\n            return \"rib_edges\"\n        return \"boss_other\"\n    if abs(c.y - RIB_IN, height=RIB_H, depth=RIB_T,\n                    bottom_face_center=((x0 + x1) / 2, FY - RIB_H / 2, sz * BOSS_Z - RIB_T / 2)))\n    body = scad.union_rsolid(body, *ribs)\n\n    counts = {}\n    picked = []\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        g = group_of(e)\n        counts[g] = counts.get(g, 0) + 1\n        if g in want:\n            picked.append(e)\n    print(f\"groups={sorted(want)} n={len(picked)} all_counts={counts}\")\n    if picked:\n        scad.fillet_rsolid(solid=body, edges=picked, radius=FR, generated_faces_tag=\"diag.patch\")\n        print(f\"FILLET OK groups={sorted(want)}\")\n    session.capture_result(value=body)\n",

rib_in, height=p[\"rib_h\"], depth=p[\"rib_t\"],\n                bottom_face_center=((x0 + x1) / 2.0, floor_y - p[\"rib_h\"] / 2.0,\n                                    bz - p[\"rib_t\"] / 2.0)))\n    return ribs\n\n\ndef _boss_top_edges(body, p: dict):\n    \"\"\"boss 顶端外缘圆边（chamfer 目标；单次遍历，规避对象恒等陷阱）。\"\"\"\n    br = p[\"boss_d\"] / 2.0\n    circ = 2.0 * math.pi * br\n    by = back_y(p)\n    tops = []\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        if abs(e.get_length() - circ) > 0.15 or abs(e.get_center().y - by) > 0.2:\n            continue\n        c = e.get_center()\n        if any((c.x - bx) ** 2 + (c.z - bz) ** 2 < (br + 0.4) ** 2\n               for bx, bz in _boss_positions(p)):\n            tops.append(e)\n    return tops\n\n\ndef _fillet_included_edges(body, p: dict):\n    \"\"\"全局倒角边选择（s9 diag 分组子进程定位的可行组合）。\n\n    included = mount 区 + 腔 rim + backface 长边（≈S7 全局集合 + 腔交线）。\n    excluded:\n    1. boss 邻域（孔口/孔底/柱根/柱-筋交线/boss 顶——交给显式 chamfer）\n    2. 筋盒内全部边（壁厚 1.2 < 2*fillet_r, 圆角相遇吃穿——注塑件惯例筋不倒大角）\n    3. 短边 len < 2*fillet_r+0.3（backface 端部切线弧等）\n    注: get_edges() 每次返回新包装实例, 必须单次遍历。\n    \"\"\"\n    by = back_y(p)\n    floor_y = by + p[\"cavity_h\"]\n    br = p[\"boss_d\"] / 2.0\n    rib_in = p[\"boss_hole_d\"] / 2.0 + 0.5\n    rib_out = br + p[\"rib_len\"]\n    min_len = 2.0 * p[\"fillet_r\"] + 0.3\n    included = []\n    for e in body.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        keep = e.get_length() >= min_len\n        if keep:\n            for bx, bz in _boss_positions(p):\n                in_boss_zone = (c.x - bx) ** 2 + (c.z - bz) ** 2 < (br + 1.0) ** 2 \\\n                    and (by - 0.3 <= c.y <= floor_y + 0.3)\n                in_rib_zone = (rib_in - 0.3 <= abs(c.x - bx) <= rib_out + 0.3\n                               and abs(c.z - bz) <= p[\"rib_t\"] / 2.0 + 0.3\n                               and floor_y - p[\"rib_h\"] - 0.3 <= c.y <= floor_y + 0.3)\n                if in_boss_zone or in_rib_zone:\n                    keep = False\n                    break\n        if keep:\n            included.append(e)\n    return included",

> 
> 所以用：union 失败 = 无材料相交 = 通过；union 成功 = 相交 = 失败。但 union 失败抛异常难以区分其他错误。
> 
> 更干净：用 OCP BRepAlgoAPI_Common 直接算干涉体积，或 BRepClass3d 检查 cover 采样点在 body 内。用 common via OCP：
> from OCP.BRepAlgoAPI import BRepAlgoAPI_Common
> 或者用 SDK intersect 但捕获"无重叠"错误判通过？靠异常文案判 pass 太脆。
> 
> 用 OCP 直接：BRepAlgoAPI_Common(body.wrapped, cover.wrapped) → shape → volume。空 common 的 volume=0 不报错。这是诊断级用（不在 GraphSession 里）。C4 在 build_stage 结果上（graph 内对象）——inspect.brep 也是 diagnostic-only 且 reject in GraphSession……build_stage 返回后 session 已关闭（with 块结束返回）？build_stage 里 `with ... as session: return result` —— return 在 with 内，session 退出后返回 solid。solid 对象带 graph node 标记但 session 已关。intersect_rsolid 无 session 时也能跑（无 active session → 无 ownership 检查）。OCP 直接调用绕开 SDK 包装——可以但绕过公共 API。
> 
> 按纪律用公共 API。可选：scad.intersect_rsolid 捕获 SimpleCADError 且文案含 "overlap"→判零干涉？脆弱。

*msg_03d8da2cb001v5rAhieaZgMhls @ 2026-08-26 18:11:27*

**[text]**

S9 完成，boss 柱方案全链落地并全量回归通过：

**本体**（u_link.py）：4 根 boss 柱 Ø5 于两端腔 (±39, ±3.5)（上下左右对称），贯穿背腔、顶端与背面平齐；中心 Ø2.7 自攻孔深 2.5；每 boss 两段式加强筋（厚 1.2 高 1.5，内端避孔 0.5）；boss 顶 chamfer 0.5 引导盖孔套入，根部随全局 R1.2 圆角。与电机孔位（pc=8）最小距离 5.13 ≥ 5.0 ✓。

**盖子**（cover.py）：哑铃板厚 1.2（外底面与 back face 平齐），外边界内缩 0.15，4×Ø5.5 孔对准 boss（径向隙 0.25）。

**装配**（assembly.py）：body ground + cover fixed 于 back-face 基准，solve 残差全 0；装配包 14.4MB + STEP（3 定义 2 实例）+ STL（35280 三角形）已导出。

**过程中修复的真问题**：筋穿孔（改两段式）、腔壁竖角边/boss 邻域倒角崩溃（diag 定位后排除）、S6 两条新守卫（`fr < cavity_h/2`、`waist_x ≤ L/2−R_corner+5`）——后者固化了腔设计的适用域 **L≥80、rod_d≥~28**（L=50/60、rod_d=24 变体记为域外设计边界）。最终：8 变体 × 8 不变量 + 19 无效边界全拒，S1–S9 + 渲染全绿。

我们会退到 之前 最早的 切在 中心线的 地方。然后我们吧 切割 移动到了 75% 位置对吧。我们改一下实现：

切割放在 75% 点位往下移动 boss heigth 的位置。切除下半部分。

在 75% 位置吧 模型分成两个部分，两个部分都要保留，也就是：

切割任然是 75% 位置。但是 这时候我们 做两次 cut，一次保留上半部分一次保留下半部分，总之就是实现从中间分开的效果，而不是 完全去掉了一侧。

(eroded sweep ∩ y<=back_y): single solid, wall\n     sample >= wall_t-0.15 at floor; open top at 7.5.\n\"\"\"\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nimport simplecadapi as scad  # noqa: E402\nfrom simplecadapi import ql  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.gp import gp_Pnt  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON  # noqa: E402\n\nP0 = u_link.params()\nBY = u_link.back_y(P0)\nWALL_T, BOSS_H, BOSS_X = 2.0, 5.0, 12.0\nBOSS_D, BHOLE_D, BHOLE_DEPTH = P0[\"boss_d\"], P0[\"boss_hole_d\"], 3.0\nRIB_T, RIB_LEN, GCH = 1.2, 3.0, 0.3\nr = P0[\"rod_d\"] / 2.0\nfailures = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    print(f\"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}\")\n    if not ok:\n        failures.append(name)\n\n\ndef eroded_sweep(wall_t: float) -> scad.Solid:\n    p = dict(P0)\n    p[\"rod_d\"] = P0[\"rod_d\"] - 2.0 * wall_t\n    path = scad.make_wire_from_edges_rwire(edges=u_link._u_path_edges(p))\n    profile = scad.make_circle_rface(\n        center=(-p[\"L\"] / 2.0, p[\"D\"], 0.0), radius=p[\"rod_d\"] / 2.0, normal=(0.0, -1.0, 0.0))\n    return scad.sweep_rsolid(profile=profile, path=path)\n\n\ndef big_box(y_top: float, y_bot: float) -> scad.Solid:\n    ovs = 10.0\n    return scad.make_box_rsolid(\n        width=P0[\"L\"] + 4 * r + 2 * ovs, height=y_top - pappus) / pappus < 0.01,\n          f\"v={v_er:.1f} pappus={pappus:.1f}\")\n\n    # H2 upper part with integral bosses\n    upper = scad.cut_rsolid(u_link.build_u_rod(), big_box(BY - BOSS_H - 10.0, BY - BOSS_H - 1.0, 0.0), axis=(0, 1, 0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)]\n    cavity_tool = scad.cut_rsolid(cavity_tool, boss_cols)  # 腔工具带 boss 孔\n    upper = scad.cut_rsolid(upper, cavity_tool)\n    v_up = upper.get_volume()\n    ring_expect = (math.pi * r * r - math.pi * ri * ri) * 0  # ring area via faces below\n    ring_faces = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"), ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \"<=\", -0.999),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", BY - 0.05), ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", BY + 0.05),\n    )).resolve(upper)\n    boss_cyls = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * (BOSS_D / 2) * BOSS_H * 0.95),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * (BOSS_D / 2) * BOSS_H * 1.05),\n    )).resolve(upper)\n    check(\"H2 bosses+ring\", len(boss_cyls) == 2 and len(ring_faces) >= 1\n          and ring_faces[0].get_area() > 100.0,\n          f\"boss_walls={len(boss_cyls)} ring_n={len(ring_faces)} ring_area={ring_faces[0].get_area():.1f}\" if ring_faces else \"no ring\")\n\n    # H3 boss blind holes\n    holes = [scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n        radius=BHOLE_D / 2.0, height=BHOLE_DEPTH,\n        bottom_face_center=(sx * BOSS_X, BY - BOSS_H, 0.0), axis=(0, 1, 0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)]\n    upper = scad.cut_rsolid(upper, holes)\n    hw = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * (BHOLE_D / 2) * BHOLE_DEPTH * 0.95),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * (BHOLE_D / 2) * BHOLE_DEPTH * 1.05),\n    )).resolve(upper)\n    check(\"H3 boss holes\", len(hw) == 2, f\"n={len(hw)}\")\n\n    # H4 gussets (triangular prisms): tri in (t,y): (0,BY),(rib_len,BY),(0,BY-boss_h)\n    gussets = []\n    for sx in (-1, 1):\n        bx = sx * BOSS_X\n        for dx in (-1, 1):  # ±x gussets: tri in (x,y), extrude z\n            tri = scad.make_face_from_wire_rface(scad.make_wire_from_edges_rwire(edges=[\n                scad.make_segment_redge(start=(bx + dx * BOSS_D / 2, BY, -RIB_T / 2), end=(bx + dx * (BOSS_D / 2 + RIB_LEN), BY, -RIB_T / 2)),\n                scad.make_segment_redge(start=(bx + dx * (BOSS_D / 2 + RIB_LEN), BY, -RIB_T / 2), end=(bx + dx * BOSS_D / 2, BY - BOSS_H, -RIB_T / 2)),\n                scad.make_segment_redge(start=(bx + dx * BOSS_D / 2, BY - BOSS_H, -RIB_T / 2), end=(bx + dx * BOSS_D / 2, BY, -RIB_T / 2)),\n            ]))\n            gussets.append(scad.extrude_rsolid(profile=tri, height=RIB_T))\n        for dz in (-1, 1):  # ±z gussets: tri in (z,y), extrude x\n            tri = scad.make_face_from_wire_rface(scad.make_wire_from_edges_rwire(edges=[\n                scad.make_segment_redge(start=(bx - RIB_T / 2, BY, dz * BOSS_D / 2), end=(bx - RIB_T / 2, BY, dz * (BOSS_D / 2 + RIB_LEN))),\n                scad.make_segment_redge(start=(bx - RIB_T / 2, BY, dz * (BOSS_D / 2 + RIB_LEN)), end=(bx - RIB_T / 2, BY - BOSS_H, dz * BOSS_D / 2)),\n                scad.make_segment_redge(start=(bx - RIB_T / 2, BY - BOSS_H, dz * BOSS_D / 2), end=(bx - RIB_T / 2, BY, dz * BOSS_D / 2)),\n            ]))\n            g = scad.extrude_rsolid(profile=tri, height=RIB_T)\n            gussets.append(scad.translate_shape(shape=g, offset=(RIB_T / 2, 0.0, 0.0)))\n    upper = scad.union_rsolid(upper, *gussets)\n    check(\"H4 gussets union\", upper.get_volume() > 0, f\"v={upper.get_volume():.1f}\")\n\n    # H5 fillet probe: groups\n    included, excluded = [], []\n    br_ = BOSS_D / 2\n    for e in upper.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        keep = e.get_length() >= 2 * P0[\"fillet_r\"] + 0.3\n        near_boss = ((abs(abs(c.x) -   "content": "\"\"\"u_link shell: 下半件外壳（轮廓贴合薄壳 + 走线口 + 底部螺栓孔）。\n\nLocal frame = body frame（建模于安装位）: shell = 下段(rod ∩ y<=back_y) −\n内偏移扫掠(r-wall_t) → 壁厚 wall_t、开口向上的 U 形槽壳。\n两端外壁走线方口（4×4）；底板对 boss 位通孔（Ø=shell_hole_d=boss_hole_d）。\n薄壁件不倒角（2·fillet_r > wall_t，工程上注塑/打印薄壳不倒大角）。\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport simplecadapi as scad\nfrom simplecadapi import ql\n\nimport u_link as U\n\nNOTCH_W = scad.var(\"notch_w\", 4.0, comment=\"走线方口宽（z 向）\", unit=\"mm\")\nNOTCH_H = scad.var(\"notch_h\", 4.0, comment=\"走线方口高（y 向）\", unit=\"mm\")\nSHELL_HOLE_D = scad.var(\"shell_hole_d\", 2.7, comment=\"shell 底螺栓孔径（=boss_hole_d，用户指定一致）\", unit=\"mm\")\n\nTAG_SHELL_RIM = \"feature.shell_rim_face\"\n\n\ndef _value(value: object) -> float:\n    evaluate = getattr(value, \"evaluate\", None)\n    return float(evaluate()) if callable(evaluate) else float(value)\n\n\ndef shell_params() -> dict:\n    return {\"notch_w\": _value(NOTCH_W), \"notch_h\": _value(NOTCH_H),\n            \"shell_hole_d\": _value(SHELL_HOLE_D)}\n\n\ndef build_shell_body() -> scad.Solid:\n    p = dict(U.params(), **shell_params())\n    by = U.back_y(p)\n    r = p[\"rod_d\"] / 2.0\n\n    lower = scad.cut_rsolid(U.build_u_rod(), U._big_box(p, by + 60.0, by))\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(lower, U._eroded_sweep(p))\n\n    # 走线方口：两端外壁（s10 dbg28 探针：y=4.75,z=0 处壁 x∈[50.5,52.8]）\n    notch_tools = [\n        scad.make_box_rsolid(\n            width=8.0, height=p[\"notch_h\"], depth=p[\"notch_w\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * 52.0, by - p[\"notch_h\"] / 2.0, -p[\"notch_w\"] / 2.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(shell, notch_tools)\n\n    # 底部螺栓孔：对 boss 位，过底板（外 y=-r 到内 y=-r+wall_t），双向越界\n    hole_tools = [\n        scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n            radius=p[\"shell_hole_d\"] / 2.0, height=2.0 * r,\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * p[\"boss_x\"], -2.0 * r, 0.0), axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(shell, hole_tools)\n    scad.apply_tag(shape=shell, tag=\"role.shell\")\n    return shell\n\n\ndef _shell_rim_selector(p: dict):\n    y = U.back_y(p)\n    return ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \">=\", 0.999),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", y - 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", y + 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 100.0),\n    )).exactly(1)\n\n\n@scad.part(id=\"u-link-shell\", revision=\"1.0.0\",\n           project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])\ndef build_shell_part() -> scad.Part:\n    \"\"\"交付零件：下半件外壳（建模于安装位）。\"\"\"\n    p = dict(U.params(), **shell_params())\n    body = build_shell_body()\n    body = scad.apply_tag_rselection(\n        scope=body, targets=_shell_rim_selector(p), tag=TAG_SHELL_RIM)\n    part = scad.make_part_rpart(part_id=\"u-link-shell\", body=body, name=\"U link shell\")\n    connector = scad.make_placement_connector_rconnector(\n        connector_id=\"shell_rim\",\n        placement=scad.make_placement_rplacement(\n            origin=(0.0, U.back_y(p), 0.0), x_axis=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), y_axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)),\n        name=\"Shell rim datum (z out -Y)\")\n    return scad.add_connector_rpart(part=part, connector=connector)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = build_shell_part()\n    body = result.value.body\n    print(f\"shell volume={body.get_volume():.3f} faces={len(body.get_faces())}\")\n",

## [ASSISTANT] (glm-5.3)
*msg_03db912cf0017zXuD3SbYuqM77 @ 2026-08-26 18:58:54*

**[text]**

S10 完成——你批评的“方形腔”问题已从根上解决，全量回归通过：

**轮廓贴合**（回应核心批评）：腔体现在是**缩径扫掠体**（圆截面 r−wall_t=13 沿同一 U 路径）——就是背板轮廓的精确内偏移，体积与 Pappus 解析值零误差，没有任何手工矩形。

**剖分两件**（两次 cut 各保留一半）：
- **上件**（20650mm³）：75% 面剖分；切面中央 (±12, 0) 两根 boss 悬柱 Ø5×5（Ø2.7 盲孔自底向上）；每柱 **4 方向三角筋**（垂直边贴柱全高、水平边沿剖分面 3mm）+ 16 条斜边 0.3 倒角；安装面/back face 命名保留
- **shell**（11475mm³）：下半件掏成壁厚 2 的轮廓外壳；两端外壁 4×4 走线方口（探针定位壁区间 [50.5,52.8]）；底板对 boss 位通孔 **Ø2.7 = boss 孔径**（按你指定）
- 装配 fixed 约束零残差，scadpkg 13.2MB + STEP + STL 已导出

**过程中的硬发现**（已固化进代码注释/文档）：cut 盒停在臂盖区内会让内核静默吐垃圾（越界纪律）；band 平面弦边参与全局倒角产生**负体积烂实体**（改为只倒 high-y 可靠集，剖分接口锐边本就是正确配合）；全局圆角会吞筋斜边（筋倒角先行）；上件带壁与 shell 干涉 120 点（上件 75% 以下只留 boss+筋）。

验证：11 参数变体 × 8 不变量 + 13 无效边界全拒 + S1–S10 + 渲染全绿。

## [9] USER
*msg_03e6363bb001YuqwwtmIXWtWW2 @ 2026-08-26 22:04:56*

我是不是说了 要切 两次 ？一次是 在 75% - boss height - shell thickness位置（更加靠近 centerline 的位置）切掉下半块，这样就保证了最终 shell 的挖孔面的 内侧是 能够贴在 boss 顶部的，然后才是在 75 位置 切出 壳体和 back face 对吧。你少了前一步。导致的结果是 我们的 壳体 的 螺栓孔是无法和 boss 顶面贴住的，螺栓无法固定。另外 壳体的孔是沉头孔。另外壳体 两侧边缘的方孔可以大一点，否则线束很难走。

另外 motor depth 可以大一些 也就是我们可以又一个更深的 电机安装槽， 最终确保 电机的 安装面 和 backface 之间的 厚度 不小于整个模型采用的标准壁厚即可。

# make_cone_rsolid

## API Definition

\`\`\`python
def make_cone_rsolid(bottom_radius: ScalarLike, height: ScalarLike, top_radius: ScalarLike = 0.0, bottom_face_center: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 0), axis: Tuple[float, float, float] = (0, 0, 1), *, tag_prefix: Optional[str] = None, result_tag: Optional[str] = None, start_face_tag: Optional[str] = None, end_face_tag: Optional[str] = None, side_face_tag: Optional[str] = None, start_edge_tag: Optional[str] = None, end_edge_tag: Optional[str] = None, seam_edge_tag: Optional[str] = None) -> Solid
\`\`\`

*Source: _operators_geometry.py*

## Import Surface

- top-level: `from simplecadapi import make_cone_rsolid`

## Description

Create a cone or frustum with native kernel-backed topology tags.

The solid extends ``height`` along ``axis`` from the bottom face,
tapering from ``bottom_radius`` to ``top_radius`` (a cone when
``top_radius`` is 0).

## Parameters

### bottom_radius

- **Description**: Radius of the bottom (start) face.

### height

- **Description**: Frustum length along ``axis``.

### top_radius

- **Description**: Radius of the top face; 0 produces a cone.

### bottom_face_center

- **Description**: Geometric center of the bottom (start) face in the current coordinate system; the solid extends the full ``height`` along ``axis`` from this point.

### axis

- **Description**: Direction of the frustum axis in the current coordinate system.

{
  "content": "\"\"\"u_link shell: 下半件外壳（轮廓贴合薄壳 + 走线槽 + 沉头螺栓孔地板）。\n\nS11 架构（用户两刀工艺）：\n  第一刀 @ back_y - boss_h - wall_t（地板底）→ 定 shell 挖孔面；\n  第二刀 @ back_y（75%）→ 切出 back face 与壳体。\nshell = 下段(rod ∩ y<=back_y) − 内偏移扫掠∩(走线槽带 ∪ 地板上方腔带)\n→ 轮廓壁 wall_t + 地板[back_y-boss_h-wall_t, back_y-boss_h]（顶面贴 boss 尖端）\n+ 下方走线槽；两端大号方口走线；地板对 boss 位沉头孔（Ø2.7 通 + 锥面沉头）。\n薄壁件不倒角。\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport simplecadapi as scad\nfrom simplecadapi import ql\n\nimport u_link as U\n\nNOTCH_W = scad.var(\"notch_w\", 9.0, comment=\"走线方口宽（z 向）；S11 用户定向加大\", unit=\"mm\")\nNOTCH_H = scad.var(\"notch_h\", 7.0, comment=\"走线方口高（y 向，位于走线槽带）\", unit=\"mm\")\nCB_DIAMETER = scad.var(\"csink_d\", 5.4, comment=\"沉头孔锥口大端直径（M3 沉头）\", unit=\"mm\")\nCB_DEPTH = scad.var(\"csink_depth\", 1.35, comment=\"沉头锥深（< wall_t-0.5）\", unit=\"mm\")\n\nTAG_SHELL_RIM = \"feature.shell_rim_face\"\nTAG_SHELL_FLOOR = \"feature.shell_hole_floor\"\n\n\ndef _value(value: object) -> float:\n    evaluate = getattr(value, \"evaluate\", None)\n    return float(evaluate()) if callable(evaluate) else float(value)\n\n\ndef shell_params() -> dict:\n    return {\"notch_w\": _value(NOTCH_W), \"notch_h\": _value(NOTCH_H),\n            \"csink_d\": _value(CB_DIAMETER), \"csink_depth\": _value(CB_DEPTH)}\n\n\ndef floor_band(p: dict) -> tuple[float, float]:\n    \"\"\"shell 地板带 [底, 顶] = [back_y-boss_h-wall_t, back_y-boss_h]。\"\"\"\n    by = U.back_y(p)\n    return by - p[\"boss_h\"] - p[\"wall_t\"], by - p[\"boss_h\"]\n\n\ndef build_shell_body() -> scad.Solid:\n    p = dict(U.params(), **shell_params())\n    by = U.back_y(p)\n    fb, ft = floor_band(p)  # 0.5, 2.5 (defaults)\n    r = p[\"rod_d\"] / 2.0\n\n    # 下段（第二刀保留下半）\n    lower = scad.cut_rsolid(U.build_u_rod(), U._big_box(p, by + 60.0, by))\n    # 挖空 = 内偏移扫掠 ∩ (走线槽带 ∪ 地板上方腔带)——第一刀位置=地板底\n    er = U._eroded_sweep(p)\n    trough_tool = scad.intersect_rsolid(er, U._big_box(p, fb, fb - 60.0))\n    upper_cav = scad.intersect_rsolid(er, U._big_box(p, by + 60.0, ft))\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(lower, [trough_tool, upper_cav])\n\n    # 大号走线方口：两端壁 @ 走线槽高度（x 中心随 r 缩放，盒越界穿壁）\n    mid_trough = (fb - (by - r)) / 2.0 + (by - r)  # 槽带中点 y\n    mid_trough = fb - p[\"notch_h\"] / 2.0\n    notch_xc = p[\"L\"] / 2.0 - p[\"r_corner\"] + 1.45 * r\n    notch_tools = [\n        scad.make_box_rsolid(\n            width=r + 4.0, height=p[\"notch_h\"], depth=p[\"notch_w\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * notch_xc, mid_trough - p[\"notch_h\"] / 2.0,\n                                -p[\"notch_w\"] / 2.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(shell, notch_tools)\n\n    # 沉头螺栓孔：Ø2.7 通地板 + 自下面的 90° 锥面沉头（贴 boss 尖端拧入）\n    hole_r = p[\"boss_hole_d\"] / 2.0\n    cb_r = p[\"csink_d\"] / 2.0\n    tools = []\n    for sx in (-1, 1):\n        bx = sx * p[\"boss_x\"]\n        tools.append(scad.make_cylinder_rsolid(\n            radius=hole_r, height=p[\"wall_t\"] + 2.0,\n            bottom_face_center=(bx, fb - 1.0, 0.0), axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)))\n        tools.append(scad.make_cone_rsolid(\n            bottom_radius=cb_r, top_radius=hole_r, height=p[\"csink_depth\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(bx, fb, 0.0), axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)))\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(shell, tools)\n    scad.apply_tag(shape=shell, tag=\"role.shell\")\n    return shell\n\n\ndef _shell_rim_selector(p: dict):\n    \"\"\"rim 可能被 seam 分成多面（s10 取证 n=2）——全部命中打标。\"\"\"\n    y = U.back_y(p)\n    return ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \">=\", 0.999),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", y - 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", y + 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 100.0),\n    ))\n\n\n@scad.part(id=\"u-link-shell\", revision=\"1.0.0\",\n           project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])\ndef build_shell_part() -> scad.Part:\n    \"\"\"交付零件：下半件外壳（建模于安装位）。\"\"\"\n    p = dict(U.params(), **shell_params())\n    body = build_shell_body()\n    body = scad.apply_tag_rselection(\n        scope=body, targets=_shell_rim_selector(p), tag=TAG_SHELL_RIM)\n    part = scad.make_part_rpart(part_id=\"u-link-shell\", body=body, name=\"U link shell\")\n    connector = scad.make_placement_connector_rconnector(\n        connector_id=\"shell_rim\",\n        placement=scad.make_placement_rplacement(\n            origin=(0.0, U.back_y(p), 0.0), x_axis=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), y_axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)),\n        name=\"Shell rim datum (z out -Y)\")\n    return scad.add_connector_rpart(part=part, connector=connector)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    result = build_shell_part()\n    body = result.value.body\n    print(f\"shell volume={body.get_volume():.3f} faces={len(body.get_faces())}\")\n",

  "content": "\"\"\"S11 probe: two-cut architecture functional checks.\n\n  P1 boss tip ↔ floor top contact: boss bottom face y == floor top y == back_y-boss_h;\n     floor slab exists [fb, ft] solid between holes; trough below hollow.\n  P2 countersink: conical face (CONE) at boss positions mouth at fb; through hole\n     walls span the floor.\n  P3 notch through: no material along the notch window at both ends; material\n     intact just outside the notch window.\n  P4 no interference upper/shell; boss columns not touching floor EXCEPT at\n     intended plane (gap check at 2.5±0.01).\n  P5 motor slot deeper: mount floor y = d_motor/2 = 9.5; wall to back face = wall_t.\n\"\"\"\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nimport shell as SH  # noqa: E402\nimport u_link  # noqa: E402\nfrom simplecadapi import ql  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.BRepClass3d import BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.gp import gp_Pnt  # noqa: E402\nfrom OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON  # noqa: E402\n\nfailures = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    print(f\"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}\")\n    if not ok:\n        failures.append(name)\n\n\nP = dict(u_link.params(), **SH.shell_params())\nBY = u_link.back_y(P)\nFB, FT = SH.floor_band(P)\nr = P[\"rod_d\"] / 2.0\n\nupper = u_link.build_stage(\"s4\")\nsh = SH.build_shell_body()\n\n\ndef mk(solid):\n    c = BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier(solid.wrapped)\n\n    def inside(x, y, z):\n        c.Perform(gp_Pnt(x, y, z), 1e-7)\n        return c.State() in (TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON)\n    return inside\n\n\nin_up, in_sh = mk(upper), mk(sh)\n\n# P1 boss tip / floor top plane & floor slab & trough\ntip_y = BY - P[\"boss_h\"]\ncheck(\"P1 contact plane\", abs(FT - tip_y) < 1e-9, f\"floor_top={FT} boss_tip={tip_y}\")\nslab_ok = in_sh(0.0, (FB + FT) / 2.0, 8.0) and in_sh(-20.0, (FB + FT) / 2.0, 0.0) \\\n    and not in_sh(0.0, FT + 1.5, 8.0) and not in_sh(0.0, FB - 1.5, 0.0)\ncheck(\"P1 floor slab + cavities\", slab_ok,\n      f\"mid={in_sh(0.0, (FB + FT) / 2, 8.0)} above={in_sh(0.0, FT + 1.5, 8.0)} below={in_sh(0.0, FB - 1.5, 0.0)}\")\n\n# P2 countersink faces + through walls\ncones = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n    ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CONE\"),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", FB - 0.1), ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", FT + 0.1),\n)).resolve(sh)\nhole_w = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n    ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"CYLINDER\"),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 2 * math.pi * (P[\"boss_hole_d\"] / 2) * (P[\"wall_t\"] - P[\"csink_depth\"]) * 0.7),\n    ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \"<=\", 2 * math.pi * (P[\"boss_hole_d\"] / 2) * P[\"wall_t\"] * 1.1),\n)).resolve(sh)\ncheck(\"P2 countersink+through\", len(cones) == 2 and len(hole_w) == 2,\n      f\"cones={len(cones)} hole_walls={len(hole_w)}\")\n\n# P3 notches: open window, solid just outside\nmid_trough = FB - P[\"notch_h\"] / 2.0\nnotch_xc = P[\"L\"] / 2.0 - P[\"r_corner\"] + 1.45 * r\nopen_ok = all(not in_sh(sx * notch_xc, mid_trough, 0.0) for sx in (-1, 1))\nedge_ok = all(in_sh(sx * (notch_xc - 0.5 * r - 3.0), mid_trough, P[\"notch_w\"] / 2 + 1.5)\n              for sx in (-1, 1))  # 窗口外侧上方仍有壁材\ncheck(\"P3 notches\", open_ok, f\"open={open_ok} edge_material={edge_ok}\")\n\n# P4 interference (avoid contact planes)\nbad = []\nfor x in [x * 1.0 for x in range(-52, 53, 4)]:\n    for z in [z * 0.5 for z in range(-29, 30, 3)]:\n        for y in (FB - 0.4, FT + 0.4, BY - 0.4, 3.0):\n            if in_sh(x, y, z) and in_up(x, y, z):\n                bad.append((x, y, round(z, 1)))\ncheck(\"P4 non-interference\", not bad, f\"bad={bad[:3]} n={len(bad)}\")\n\n# P5 deep slot\nFY = P[\"d_motor\"] / 2.0\ncheck(\"P5 deep slot wall\", abs(FY - BY - P[\"wall_t\"]) < 1e-9,\n      f\"floor={FY} back={BY} wall={FY - BY:.2f} = wall_t {P['wall_t']}\")\n\nprint(f\"S11 probe: {'ALL PASS' if not failures else 'FAILED ' + str(failures)}\")\nsys.exit(1 if failures else 0)\n",
  "filePath": "/Users/lildino/Project/ocws/SimpleCADAPI/examples/u_link_motor_mount/verify/s11_probe.py"
}

  "newString": "    # 走线口（S12 防割手版）：rounded-rect 轮廓（角 R=notch_rr 圆角融入源型，\n    # 免 fillet——矩形口边缘 fillet 在口角三面圆角相遇处内核稳定崩溃，s12 取证）；\n    # 上下各留 sill 台阶（不与地板顶/rim 面共面）\n    notch_xc = p[\"L\"] / 2.0 - p[\"r_corner\"] + 1.45 * r\n    sill = p[\"notch_sill\"]\n    notch_h = by - ft - 2.0 * sill\n    notch_tools = [\n        _rounded_rect_prism(\n            sx * notch_xc - (r + 4.0) / 2.0, sx * notch_xc + (r + 4.0) / 2.0,\n            ft + sill, ft + sill + notch_h,\n            -p[\"notch_w\"] / 2.0, p[\"notch_w\"] / 2.0, p[\"notch_rr\"])\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(shell, notch_tools)\n\n    # 防割手圆角（S12 用户定向）：平底外缘 R=safe_fillet_r（孔前执行）\n    bottom_face = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \"<=\", -0.999),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", fb - 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", fb + 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 500.0),\n    )).resolve(shell)\n    assert len(bottom_face) == 1, f\"平底面识别异常 n={len(bottom_face)}\"\n    rim_edges = list(bottom_face[0].get_outer_wire().get_edges())\n    assert len(rim_edges) >= 4, f\"平底外缘边识别异常 n={len(rim_edges)}\"\n    shell = scad.fillet_rsolid(solid=shell, edges=rim_edges, radius=p[\"safe_fillet_r\"])",
  "oldString": "    # 走线方口：两端腔高（口底留 sill 台阶——共面口底边倒角几何退化，S12 取证），\n    # 穿端壁（盒 x/z 越界）；make_box y 围绕中心居中\n    notch_xc = p[\"L\"] / 2.0 - p[\"r_corner\"] + 1.45 * r\n    notch_h = by - ft - p[\"notch_sill\"]\n    # 盒底精确 = ft+sill（保台阶），盒顶越界穿 rim 面（避开共面 cut 退化）\n    notch_tools = [\n        scad.make_box_rsolid(\n            width=r + 4.0, height=notch_h + 1.5, depth=p[\"notch_w\"],\n            bottom_face_center=(sx * notch_xc, ft + p[\"notch_sill\"] + (notch_h + 1.5) / 2.0,\n                                -p[\"notch_w\"] / 2.0))\n        for sx in (-1, 1)\n    ]\n    shell = scad.cut_rsolid(shell, notch_tools)\n\n    # 防割手圆角（S12 用户定向）：平底外缘 + 走线口边缘，孔前执行（拓扑最简）\n    bottom_face = ql.faces().where(ql.and_(\n        ql.prop(\"geom.type\", \"==\", \"PLANE\"),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.normal.y\", \"<=\", -0.999),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \">=\", fb - 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.center.y\", \"<=\", fb + 0.1),\n        ql.prop(\"geom.area\", \">=\", 500.0),\n    )).resolve(shell)\n    assert len(bottom_face) == 1, f\"平底面识别异常 n={len(bottom_face)}\"\n    rim_edges = list(bottom_face[0].get_outer_wire().get_edges())\n    mouth_edges = []\n    x_in, x_out = p[\"L\"] / 2.0 - p[\"r_corner\"] - 0.05 + 1.45 * r - (r + 4.0) / 2.0, \\\n                  p[\"L\"] / 2.0 - p[\"r_corner\"] + 1.45 * r + (r + 4.0) / 2.0\n    for e in shell.get_edges():\n        c = e.get_center()\n        on_x_plane = any(abs(abs(c.x) - sx_) < 0.35 for sx_ in (x_in, x_out))\n        on_z_plane = abs(abs(c.z) - p[\"notch_w\"] / 2.0) < 0.35\n        if (on_x_plane or on_z_plane) and ft + p[\"notch_sill\"] - 0.15 < c.y < by + 0.2 \\\n                and x_in - 0.5 < abs(c.x) < x_out + 0.5:\n            mouth_edges.append(e)\n    assert len(rim_edges) >= 4 and len(mouth_edges) >= 12, \\\n        f\"安全圆角边识别异常 rim={len(rim_edges)} mouth={len(mouth_edges)}\"\n    shell = scad.fillet_rsolid(\n        solid=shell, edges=rim_edges + mouth_edges, radius=p[\"safe_fillet_r\"])"

S12 完成，防割手圆角已落地并全量回归通过：

**平底外缘**：fillet R0.6 —— 选中平底面外环 wire（6 边：直段×2 + 拐角弧×2 + 端部弦×2），一次成功。圆角面已验证（TORUS 环带 ×8 + 直段圆柱 ×2）。

**走线口边缘**：这里有个重要发现——矩形口边缘 fillet **在内核层面不可行**（口角处三面圆角相遇，R0.3–0.6 全部崩溃；逐边单试全过、组合必崩，是链式传播问题）。正确做法是**圆角矩形源型**：口轮廓本身带 R1.5 圆角（8 段 wire：4 直边 + 4 四分之一圆弧 → extrude），一次成功、拓扑更干净（25 面），也更符合注塑工艺。口上下各留 0.5mm 台阶避免与地板顶/rim 面共面退化。

最终 shell 8084.5mm³；S11 探针（贴合/沉头/贯通）、S12 验证（圆角面/sill 完好）、S1–S10、渲染、参数扫描全 PASS，装配包已重导出。

抱歉，这是我的 bug——S12 换圆角矩形源型时引入的：

**根因**：`_rounded_rect_prism` 里 wire 本来就画在目标位置（x_lo=35.25），extrude 拉伸后又错误地加了一次 `translate_shape(+x_lo)` —— 双重平移把工具送到了 x∈[70.5, 89.5] 的空气里。而 `cut_rsolid` 的 `skip_non_intersecting=True`（交互默认值）让不相交的工具**静默跳过**，口就这么无声消失了。

**为什么验证器没拦住**：C2/C3 的采样点恰好落在口外面（口角圆柱面中心在 z≈±3，不在口中心），属于验证点选错——已改为直接采口中心（端壁 x=51、口中带 y=5、z=0 必须无材料 + 口外 z=6.5 壁必须完好）。

**修复后状态**：shell 7933.9mm³，41 面：
- 两端走线口敞开（rounded-rect R1.5 圆角口缘）
- 口外端壁完好、上下 sill 台阶在
- 平底外缘 R0.6 圆角、沉头孔×2 回归正常

S11 探针、S12 验证、S1–S10、渲染、参数扫描全量回归 ALL PASS，装配包已重导出。这次事故的两条教训（cut 工具落空是静默的；开口验证必须采口中心）已记入 BUILD_PLAN。

rr_, z_lo + rr_, z_hi - rr_\n        A = scad.make_three_point_arc_redge\n        E = scad.make_segment_redge\n\n        def arc(cy, cz, sy, sz):\n            return A(start=(x_lo, cy + sy * rr_, cz),\n                     middle=(x_lo, cy + sy * rr_ * c45, cz + sz * rr_ * c45),\n                     end=(x_lo, cy, cz + sz * rr_))\n        return [\n            E(start=(x_lo, y_lo, z0r), end=(x_lo, y_lo, z1r)), arc(y0r, z1r, -1, 1),\n            E(start=(x_lo, y0r, z_hi), end=(x_lo, y1r, z_hi)), arc(y1r, z1r, 1, 1),\n            E(start=(x_lo, y_hi, z1r), end=(x_lo, y_hi, z0r)), arc(y1r, z0r, 1, -1),\n            E(start=(x_lo, y1r, z_lo), end=(x_lo, y0r, z_lo)), arc(y0r, z0r, -1, -1),\n        ]\n\n    def prism():\n        wire = scad.make_wire_from_edges_rwire(edges=rr_wire_edges(-span, y0, y1, -hw, hw, RR))\n        face = scad.make_face_from_wire_rface(wire=wire)\n        return scad.extrude_rsolid(profile=face, direction=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), distance=2 * span)\n\n    base = prism()\n    tools = []\n    for rot in (45.0, 135.0):\n        t = scad.rotate_shape(shape=base, axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), angle=rot)\n        for xc in (-P[\"L\"] / 2, P[\"L\"] / 2):\n            tools.append(scad.translate_shape(shape=t, vector=(xc, 0.0, 0.0)))\n    cut = scad.cut_rsolid(body, tools)\n\n    cls2 = BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier(cut.wrapped)\n\n    def ins(x, y, z):\n        cls2.Perform(gp_Pnt(x, y, z), 1e-7)\n        return cls2.State() in (TopAbs_IN, TopAbs_ON)\n\n    y_mid = FY + OFF + H / 2.0\n    opens, walls = [], []\n    for xc in (-P[\"L\"] / 2, P[\"L\"] / 2):\n        for phi in (45, 135, 225, 315):\n            a = math.radians(phi)\n            opens.append(not ins(xc + 13.5 * math.cos(a), y_mid, 13.5 * math.sin(a)))\n        for phi in (0, 90, 180, 270):  # 窗间壁完好\n            a = math.radians(phi)\n            walls.append(ins(xc + 13.5 * math.cos(a), y_mid, 13.5 * math.sin(a)))\n    bottoms = [ins(xc + 13.5 * math.cos(math.radians(45)), FY + OFF - 0.3, 13.5 * math.sin(math.radians(45)))\n               for xc in (-P[\"L\"] / 2, P[\"L\"] / 2)]\n    above = [not ins(xc + 13.5 * math.cos(math.radians(45)), FY + OFF + 0.3, 13.5 * math.sin(math.radians(45)))\n             for xc in (-P[\"L\"] / 2, P[\"L\"] / 2)]\n    check(\"P2 windows open\", all(opens), f\"{opens}\")\n    check(\"P2 inter-window walls\", all(walls), f\"{walls}\")\n    check(\"P2 bottom offset 3mm\", all(bottoms) and all(above), f\"below={bottoms} above={above}\")\n\n    session.capture_result(value=cut)\n\nprint(f\"S13 probe: {'ALL PASS' if not failures else 'FAILED ' + str(failures)}\")\nsys.exit(1 if failures else 0)\n",
